newsitem.title: FRANCE: Algeria says rebels killed 18 people overnight.
newsitem.headline: Algeria says rebels killed 18 people overnight.

text.p: Moslem guerrillas killed 18 people in an overnight attack in Algeria's coastal province of Tipaza, 60 km (37 miles) west of Algiers, the Algerian security forces said on Monday.
They said 18 people were wounded in the attack.

The security forces statement, carried by the official Algerian news agency APS, said the 18 killed had been "assassinated in a cowardly way" -- the term security officials use when victims have had their throats cut by rebels.
They blamed the attack on a "group of terrorists", the official term for Moslem guerrillas who have been fighting the government since 1992.
